payload.reason: The evidence indicates that NCEL is effective in improving performance metrics and outperforms baseline methods across various datasets.

claims.text: NCEL achieves the best performance with an average gain of 2% on Micro F1 and 3% on Macro F1 compared to other methods.
NCEL consistently outperforms various baselines, demonstrating favorable generalization ability across different datasets.
In both easy and hard datasets, NCEL outperforms all baseline methods, indicating its effectiveness in diverse scenarios.
